film.title: The Mysterious Oriu Houses - Hidden in the Wilderness of Corsica
film.creator: Schwendi Colours
film.note: An on-location walk among the orii: natural granite cavities enclosed with stone walls. The film follows the heritage trail near Monacia-d’Aullène and a hillside extension.
film.placement_status: Regional guide; individual shelter pins pending exact identification

metadata.title: The Mysterious Oriu Houses - Hidden in the Wilderness of Corsica
metadata.description: This Mini-Documentary is about the fascinating ancient Oriu buildings in Corsica.

review: Uploader metadata, automatic captions and original frames at 20, 70, 130, 200 and 270 seconds checked. Shows exterior/interior shelter footage and walking route. Captions identify Monacia-d’Aullène, not Canni. No exact shelter coordinates or dating inferred from generic title. Film interpretation is not adopted as archaeological fact.
